Ocr.Prompt: Transcribe all visible text faithfully as clean Markdown. Preserve the document structure, including headings, page headers and footers, paragraphs, lists, and tables. Put identifiable page headers and footers on separate lines prefixed with Header: or Footer:. Do not include bounding boxes, coordinates, positional numbers, or labels such as title [x1, y1, x2, y2] or text [x1, y1, x2, y2]. Do not summarize or add commentary. Mark unreadable text as [illegible].
